label: NORA-B20-B21-B22 (Nordic nRF54L15/L10/L05)
pending_reason: Bluetooth LE needs no u-blox calibration table; the nRF54L trim values ship in FICR and the Nordic HAL applies them. Still open: the u-blox TX power setting.

notes: Replace PLUS_4 with the required output power. Account for antenna gain; see the NORA-B20-B21-B22 system integration manual, Regulatory compliance.

mac.source: Nordic FICR DEVICEADDR (random static Bluetooth address). u-blox programs no address on NORA-B2.
notes: Zephyr and NCS use the FICR address as the identity address by default; the beacon sample prints it as 'advertising as ...'.
